messages:
Ellen: Starting thread for quick decisions on the 'Inkwell' dark theme: chart colors, syntax readability on long sessions, and the theme toggle label. Keep replies short.
Tom: Charts: when 4+ lines overlap the hues collapse. Recommend increasing lightness deltas and adding a 1px semi-opaque stroke between series. Avoid same perceived L values next to each other.
Rae: Syntax: identifiers are currently bright cyan and cause glare. Move ids to muted teal, keep hot cyan only for links. Also bump inline code padding slightly to reduce visual clutter.
Omar: Accessibility: legend text is 12px/#98A7B0 on #06080A  that's under 4.5:1. Options: bump to 14px or darken to #BFC9D4. Prefer 14px for clarity.
Ellen: Copy tweak: drop "Dim" label. Use explicit "Appearance: Light / Dark / System" and aria-label "Toggle appearance". Add tooltip "T to toggle".
Tom: Heatmaps: prefer luminance-first ramp so ordering survives colorblind sims. To avoid flatness, add very low-chroma overlay for texture and keep 1px cell dividers instead of patterns.
Rae: Small CSS token example to test in console: ```css :root{ --bg:#06080A; --text:hsl(210 9% 88%); --muted:hsl(210 6% 66%); --id-teal:hsl(175 40% 60%); --link:#5FF2FF; } ```
Omar: Perf note: avoid per-cell raster patterns; prefer CSS borders or composite canvas pass. PM wants <10ms extra paint on mid-tier mobile.
design-bot: Created task INK-7210 and attached Figma + test checklist (internal).
Ellen: Plan: I'll update Figma with two variants (Luminance-first + subtle chroma vs Muted-spectrum), set legend to 14px, and schedule a 15-min sync Thursday. Thanks :thumbsup:
